paper.title: Forest through the Trees: Building Cross-Sections of Stock Returns

definitions.LME: log(total_mv) for median ordering; total_mv weights value-weighted portfolios
definitions.return: unadjusted monthly close-to-close return; cash distributions are not added
definitions.point_in_time: income/balance rows require ann_date <= signal month-end
definitions.portfolio_weight: market-cap weighted within each node, multiplied by 2^(-depth/2)
definitions.risk_free_rate: 0 because no local Treasury-bill series was supplied

tree.split: node-conditional unweighted median; low <= median, high > median

split.note: Local data are too short for the paper's 20/10/23-year timeline; 60/24/remainder months are used.

ap_pruning.selection: weights are fixed from training; lambda0/lambda2 and target-K LASSO are selected by validation Sharpe

interpretation: SDF weights may be signed; selected AP Tree nodes are long-only managed portfolios, but their SDF combination is not a long-only trading strategy.
